items.expected: The calculation provides a defensible test of the qualitative heavy-atom triplet-sensitizer hypothesis only when state identity, geometry validation and vertical-versus-adiabatic distinctions are documented; the published interpretation links selenium-associated SOC to enhanced ISC but does not make numerical agreement universal.
